data.one_liner: A lightweight, reflection‑free DI framework for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Stark lets you register singletons and factories, retrieve them anywhere, and optionally scope them to widget lifecycles. It supports named injections, dynamic parameters, and disposable objects.
use_when: You need simple DI without code generation or reflection
You want scoped lifetimes tied to widget state
You prefer a small API surface over feature‑rich containers
avoid_when: You require compile‑time safety via code‑gen (e.g., injectable)
You need advanced features like lazy async factories or multi‑binding
You already use a DI solution integrated with other libraries
strengths: No reflection – works on all Flutter platforms
Supports scoped lifetimes and disposable cleanup
weaknesses: No compile‑time checks, runtime errors if types mismatch
Limited advanced features compared to larger containers
Manual registration can become verbose in large apps

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, zero‑codegen DI with similar API and broader community support
